title: Release and open source: agent skills for TYPO3
header: Release and open source in 94 seconds
description: Ship a first release that keeps its promises, write docs that render on docs.typo3.org, harden the supply chain and contribute to the Core. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 94 seconds: Release and open source, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-initial-release, typo3-docs, typo3-core-contributions, enterprise-readiness). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: Shipping an extension takes more than code: a release, documentation and a safe supply chain.
Release and open source: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Prepares the first public 1.0.0 release of an extension for TER or Packagist.
Updating version strings is the smallest part of a release.
Writes extension documentation that renders on docs.typo3.org, from guides.xml to screenshots.
A wrong namespace in guides.xml stops a manual from rendering, so the skill generates that file instead of typing it.
Helps contribute to TYPO3 Core: Forge issues, Gerrit patches, cherry-picks and CI logs.
Gerrit has its own rules, from work-in-progress pushes to keeping the Change-Id.
Assesses production readiness: supply-chain security, CI/CD hardening and quality gates.
It makes the build and signing of a release traceable, from SHA-pinned actions to signed artefacts.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
